fullText.simplified:
第十五章、恍然大悟

    孙林愤怒极了，他没想到会有这样卑鄙无耻的古董商。
    “季平先生，您最痛恨的就是那些牺牲别人利益、让自己变富的人。十几年前，您就居住在南京，所以您当时一定做了什么，让这个卑鄙无耻的古董商付出代价，对不对？”孙林还在愤愤不平地说着。
    “他死了。”季平从容地说道。
    “什么？死……死了？”孙林瞪大了眼睛。孙林是了解季平的。他劫富济贫，所以穷人爱他，富人恨他，但他绝对不会杀人。
    “就在我着手行动的时候，他死了！他的头上全是血，挂在了街中心的路灯上。没有人知道他是怎么死的，从此南京市再也没有了梅放之这个古董商。”季平平静地回忆起了当年的往事。
    “他叫什么？”孙林敏锐地察觉到了什么。
    季平指了指报纸上，说道：“梅放之。”
    “这名字……”孙林斟酌了一下，意识到了问题的关键，他抬头看了一眼季平。
    “说吧。”季平等着他分析下去。
    “‘梅放之’和‘梅望止’，这两个名字太相似了，而且这两个人都是做古董文玩生意的。我听到过梅望止跟别人聊天，他有南京口音。所以，他们其实是同一个人！三十四号住户‘梅望止’就是当年那个无耻的古董商，牺牲别人的利益，成全自己！然后他在南京假死，跑来了西京市！”孙林滔滔不绝地分析着，越说越兴奋。
    季平欣赏地点点头，然后拿出这次去南京找到的老照片。没错，就是他！梅望止就是当年的梅放之。他骗取了十二颗明珠，摇身一变，成了富人生活在西京市的丝绸花园。
    “难怪……难怪我跟您介绍三十四号住户的时候，您也像什么都知道了的样子。”孙林有点儿尴尬地说道。
    季平笑了笑，看着孙林没说话。
    “啊！这才是您当初让我住进三十三号房的真正原因吧！！借助三十三号房的传闻，找办法对付柳也惠和梅放之。”孙林恍然大悟地抬起头。
    季平又笑了笑，喝了一口茶，轻轻地点了点头。
    看着眼前的资料，孙林感慨地说：“这丝绸花园，果然不是普通人居住的地方。”
    “我要谢谢你，孙林，你帮我找到了一个好计划。”季平眯起了眼睛，若有所思地说道。
    “什么计划？”孙林的眼睛闪过一道光芒。
    “一石二鸟的计划。”显然，季平已经做好了决定。
    “我要怎么做？”孙林预感马上会有大事发生。
    “三十三号房是个好地方，我们要把这出戏继续唱下去。”季平的嘴角露出了一丝神秘的微笑。

第十五章、恍然大悟

    孫林憤怒極了，他沒想到會有這樣卑鄙無恥的古董商。
    “季平先生，您最痛恨的就是那些犧牲別人利益、讓自己變富的人。十幾年前，您就居住在南京，所以您當時一定做了什麼，讓這個卑鄙無恥的古董商付出代價，對不對？”孫林還在憤憤不平地說著。
    “他死了。”季平從容地說道。
    “什麼？死……死了？”孫林瞪大了眼睛。孫林是了解季平的。他劫富濟貧，所以窮人愛他，富人恨他，但他絕對不會殺人。
    “就在我著手行動的時候，他死了！他的頭上全是血，掛在了街中心的路燈上。沒有人知道他是怎麼死的，從此南京市再也沒有了梅放之這個古董商。”季平平靜地回憶起了當年的往事。
    “他叫什麼？”孫林敏銳地察覺到了什麼。
    季平指了指報紙上，說道：“梅放之。”
    “這名字……”孫林斟酌了一下，意識到了問題的關鍵，他抬頭看了一眼季平。
    “說吧。”季平等著他分析下去。
    “‘梅放之’和‘梅望止’，這兩個名字太相似了，而且這兩個人都是做古董文玩生意的。我聽到過梅望止跟別人聊天，他有南京口音。所以，他們其實是同一個人！三十四號住戶‘梅望止’就是當年那個無恥的古董商，犧牲別人的利益，成全自己！然後他在南京假死，跑來了西京市！”孫林滔滔不絕地分析著，越說越興奮。
    季平欣賞地點點頭，然後拿出這次去南京找到的老照片。沒錯，就是他！梅望止就是當年的梅放之。他騙取了十二顆明珠，搖身一變，成了富人生活在西京市的絲綢花園。
    “難怪……難怪我跟您介紹三十四號住戶的時候，您也像什麼都知道了的樣子。”孫林有點兒尷尬地說道。
    季平笑了笑，看著孫林沒說話。
    “啊！這才是您當初讓我住進三十三號房的真正原因吧！！借助三十三號房的傳聞，找辦法對付柳也惠和梅放之。”孫林恍然大悟地抬起頭。
    季平又笑了笑，喝了一口茶，輕輕地點了點頭。
    看著眼前的資料，孫林感慨地說：“這絲綢花園，果然不是普通人居住的地方。”
    “我要謝謝你，孫林，你幫我找到了一個好計劃。”季平瞇起了眼睛，若有所思地說道。
    “什麼計劃？”孫林的眼睛閃過一道光芒。
    “一石二鳥的計劃。”顯然，季平已經做好了決定。
    “我要怎麼做？”孫林預感馬上會有大事發生。
    “三十三號房是個好地方，我們要把這齣戲繼續唱下去。”季平的嘴角露出了一絲神秘的微笑。

sentences.english: Looking at the information in front of him, Sun Lin said with emotion, “This Silk Garden is indeed not a place where ordinary people live.”

sentences.simplified: “我要谢谢你，孙林，你帮我找到了一个好计划。”季平眯起了眼睛，若有所思地说道。
sentences.traditional: “我要謝謝你，孫林，你幫我找到了一個好計劃。”季平瞇起了眼睛，若有所思地說道。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ yào xiè xie nǐ sūn lín nǐ bāng wǒ zhǎo dào le yí ge hǎo jì huà jì píng mī qǐ le yǎn jing ruò yǒu suǒ sī de shuō dào
sentences.english: “I want to thank you, Sun Lin. You helped me find a good plan,” said Ji Ping thoughtfully, squinting his eyes.

sentences.simplified: “什么计划？”孙林的眼睛闪过一道光芒。
sentences.traditional: “什麼計劃？”孫林的眼睛閃過一道光芒。
sentences.pinyin: shén me jì huà sūn lín de yǎn jing shǎn guò yí dào guāng máng
sentences.english: “What plan?” A glint flashed in Sun Lin’s eyes.

sentences.simplified: “一石二鸟的计划。”显然，季平已经做好了决定。
sentences.traditional: “一石二鳥的計劃。”顯然，季平已經做好了決定。
sentences.pinyin: yì shí èr niǎo de jì huà xiǎn rán jì píng yǐ jīng zuò hǎo le jué dìng
sentences.english: “A plan to kill two birds with one stone.” Clearly, Ji Ping had already made his decision.

sentences.simplified: “我要怎么做？”孙林预感马上会有大事发生。
sentences.traditional: “我要怎麼做？”孫林預感馬上會有大事發生。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ yào zěn me zuò sūn lín yù gǎn mǎ shàng huì yǒu dà shì fā shēng
sentences.english: “What should I do?” Sun Lin had a premonition that something big was about to happen.

sentences.simplified: “三十三号房是个好地方，我们要把这出戏继续唱下去。”
sentences.traditional: “三十三號房是個好地方，我們要把這齣戲繼續唱下去。”
sentences.pinyin: sān shí sān hào fáng shì ge hǎo dì fang wǒ men yào bǎ zhè chū xì jì xù chàng xià qù
sentences.english: “The house at number thirty-three is a good place. We need to continue singing this opera.”

sentences.simplified: 季平的嘴角露出了一丝神秘的微笑。
sentences.traditional: 季平的嘴角露出了一絲神秘的微笑。
sentences.pinyin: jì píng de zuǐ jiǎo lòu chū le yì sī shén mì de wēi xiào
sentences.english: A hint of a mysterious smile appeared at the corner of Ji Ping’s mouth.

sentence_translations: Chapter 15: A Sudden Realization
Sun Lin was extremely angry. He had never thought there could be such a despicable and shameless antique dealer.
“Mr. Ji Ping, the people you hate the most are those who sacrifice other people’s interests to enrich themselves.
A decade or so ago, you were living in Nanjing, ..
.. so you must have done something at the time to make that despicable antique dealer pay, right?”
Sun Lin was still speaking indignantly.
“He’s dead!” said Ji Ping calmly.
“What? Dead … dead?” Sun Lin’s eyes widened.
Sun Lin understood Ji Ping.
He robs the rich to give to the poor, so the poor love him and the rich hate him, but he would never kill anyone.
“Just as I was about to take action, he died! His head was covered in blood, hanging from the streetlight in the center of town.
No one knows how he died, and since then, there has been no antique dealer named Mei Fangzhi in Nanjing.”
Ji Ping calmly recalled the events of that year.
“What was his name?” Sun Lin had perceptively noticed something.
Ji Ping pointed to the newspaper and said, “Mei Fangzhi.”
“This name …” Sun Lin pondered for a moment and, realizing the crux of the problem, looked up at Ji Ping.
“Speak!” Ji Ping waited for him to continue his analysis.
“The two names ‘Mei Fangzhi’ and ‘Mei Wangzhi’ are very similar, and both of these people are in the antiques and collectibles business.
I’ve heard Mei Wangzhi chatting with others. He has a Nanjing accent. So, they are actually the same person!
The resident of the house at number thirty-four, ‘Mei Wangzhi’, is that shameless antique dealer from years ago.
He sacrificed the interests of others to benefit himself!  Then he faked his death in Nanjing and ran off to Xijing!”
Sun Lin’s analysis flowed out in a ceaseless torrent, becoming more and more excited as he spoke.
Ji Ping nodded appreciatively, then took out the old photos he found on his trip to Nanjing.
Yes, it’s him! Mei Wangzhi is the Mei Fangzhi from back then.
He obtained the twelve pearls by deception and transformed himself into a wealthy man living in Silk Garden in Xijing.
“No wonder … no wonder when I introduced the resident of the house at number thirty-four to you, ..
.. you seemed to know everything already,” said Sun Lin, a little awkwardly.
Ji Ping smiled and looked at Sun Lin without saying a word.
“Ah …! So this is the real reason you had me move into the house at number thirty-three!!
You wanted to make use of the rumors about the house at number thirty-three to deal with Liu Yehui and Mei Fangzhi.”
Sun Lin raised his head in sudden realization.
Ji Ping smiled again, took a sip of tea, and gently nodded.
Looking at the information in front of him, Sun Lin said with emotion, “This Silk Garden is indeed not a place where ordinary people live.”
“I want to thank you, Sun Lin. You helped me find a good plan,” said Ji Ping thoughtfully, squinting his eyes.
“What plan?” A glint flashed in Sun Lin’s eyes.
“A plan to kill two birds with one stone.” Clearly, Ji Ping had already made his decision.
“What should I do?” Sun Lin had a premonition that something big was about to happen.
“The house at number thirty-three is a good place. We need to continue singing this opera.”
A hint of a mysterious smile appeared at the corner of Ji Ping’s mouth.
